newsitem.title: USA: Egypt buys 100,000 T U.S. HRW wheat - US exporters.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 100,000 T U.S. HRW wheat - US exporters.

text.p: Egypt bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. number two or better hard red winter wheat for August to October delivery in a private tender, U.S. exporters said.
The wheat was priced at around $170.00 per tonne, cost and freight, they added. Further details of the purchase were not immediately available.
Egypt had sought 15,000 tonnes wheat for August 5-20 shipment, 35,000 tonnes for September 5-20 shipment and 50,000 tonnes for October 5-20 shipment.
